issues.description: Paper lists PNEC as a CellRef cell type and mentions PNEC as a rare epithelial subtype in disease use cases, but no PNEC-specific marker genes are explicitly provided in the Markdown. No formal PNEC markers can be extracted.

All existing extraction candidates correspond to non-target cell types (AT1, iMON, goblet, SMG mucous, deuterosomal, SVEC, maDC, RAS, mouse developmental cells, KRT5-/KRT17+ pathologic cells) and do not match target_cell_scope L4:Pulmonary neuroendocrine cell; all are excluded.
Mouse-derived candidates (Sox9, Id2, Ager, Hopx, Lamp3, Sftpc, Abca3, Cldn4, Krt19, Krt8, Foxf1, Kit) are outside task_species Homo sapiens and are also non-PNEC, so they are excluded.

Several candidate entries were upgraded from cluster_enriched/context-only to figure_labeled or annotation_marker based on explicit marker-gene tables or gene-defined cell type names, but this does not change their exclusion due to scope mismatch.
